Eli / Marissa —

Appended are concise answers and the referenced artifacts. Attaching: pentest-summary-2026.pdf (exec summary, findings redacted per policy), sbom-cyclonedx-202611.json (component list for VPC deployment), remediation-plan-montclair.xlsx (TTR targets & owner matrix).

Summary answers (high level):
- SAST: We run static analysis on all server and infra-as-code repos using Semgrep and internal SAST checks as part of CI with every PR. Full repo scans run weekly; PR-level scans on every commit.
- DAST: We run authenticated DAST scans against staging every two weeks using an instrumented ZAP pipeline and targeted smoke scans pre-release. Findings are triaged within our product-security queue.
- Pen test cadence & vendor: Annual third-party penetration test performed by SentinelRed (Nov 2026). Scope: production-like staging and public API endpoints. Executive summary attached; no critical exposures in prod surface discovered. High findings (n=3) were environment configuration and unauthenticated info disclosure; all high findings have mitigations in place and tracked in our remediation workbook.
- Patch SLAs (target time-to-remediate): Critical: 48 hours from detection/triage; High: 7 calendar days; Medium: 30 calendar days. SLA applies to vendor-supplied patches and in-scope product vulnerabilities. We track SLA compliance in our security dashboard and will provide summary metrics on request.
- SBOM: We produce CycloneDX SBOM exports per release and on-demand for a deployment bundle. The attached JSON is the SBOM slice scoped to the server-side components you specified.
- Attestations: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (available upon NDA). We can provide a redacted report or SOC letter as part of the compliance pack.

If you want a 30-minute walkthrough of the attachments and the remediation plan, suggest Tue 11/30 10:00–10:30am ET.

Laura Bennett
